program_name: Revolut Affiliate Programme (Retail track) — performance-based, via an affiliate network
legal_entity: Revolut (entity not named on the affiliate pages; group entities Revolut Ltd (UK) and Revolut Bank UAB (EEA))
application_conditions: 'Anyone can apply to become a Revolut affiliate'; adult and gambling sites rejected; individuals apply under their full name, companies under their legal business name. Retail and Business are separate programmes (Business requires a business-specific audience). A Compliance Survey must be completed before access is granted (onboarding guide). Cryptocurrency promotions 'require Revolut approval before going live' (become-a-revolut-affiliate page).
paid_action: Retail: commission 'after a lead signs up, passes KYC, and tops up' (become-a-revolut-affiliate page) — or, per the onboarding guide, per 'New Active Person' (NAP): sign-up plus at least one outbound action within a 30-day attribution window (card payment, ATM withdrawal, transfer, currency or crypto exchange, stock purchase, donation; top-ups do not count).
validation_conditions: NAP definition above; 30-day attribution window; commission reversal and termination for keyword-policy violations (no bidding on 'Revolut' terms, incl. misspellings).

commission.model_note: Amounts not published: 'We'll give you the details of commissions when you sign up to the programme' / 'Details of commissions are provided when signing up to the programme.' Purely performance-based: 'We do not invest in fixed or onboarding fees.'

payout.holdbacks_note: Commissions reversed on keyword-policy violations; the Premium-trial offer 'can be amended/terminated at anytime, at Revolut's discretion'.

rules_note: No bidding on Revolut brand keywords (exact, broad, misspelled); no altered or custom visuals without agreement; Premium-trial copy must carry the trial T&Cs and a note that Standard plan fees apply after the trial. Crypto promotions need prior approval. Nobody contacted, no application made.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated for affiliates; 'restrictions and disclaimers may vary between markets' and geographical restrictions apply to the offer.

evidence.title: Revolut — Become an affiliate partner
evidence.excerpt: Network: Impact ('sign up through Impact'). Retail commission after sign-up, KYC and top-up; Business after onboarding and first month's fee. 'We'll give you the details of commissions when you sign up to the programme.' Monthly payments, 30-day terms. Crypto promotions require Revolut approval. Latest news item 24 April 2024.

evidence.title: Revolut's Affiliate Programme — onboarding guide
evidence.excerpt: Platform: Rakuten ('Search for Revolut there and apply'); Compliance Survey first; Migration Links vs New Links. Commission per New Active Person (NAP) with a 30-day attribution window; 'Payments are rolling monthly, on 30-day terms'; keyword policy and visual-asset rules; Premium trial evergreen offer.

notes: The two official affiliate pages name different networks (Impact vs Rakuten) and different paid actions (KYC + top-up vs NAP with an outbound action, top-ups excluded). Commission amounts are not public. The crypto-card record (data/cards/revolut-crypto-card.json) is the product this programme would be used for; crypto promotions need Revolut's prior approval. Decision for David: whether to apply at all (bank card with a crypto feature) and through which network.
